title: Artifact reference vocabularies coexist beside DurableArtifactRef without a stated mapping (ArtifactRef v1, Observability, Evidence, Reliability diagnostics, execution metadata record)
impact: The owner doc promises one shared reference contract with mandatory digest, lineage and scope. At least four other reference-only contracts exist that do not import DurableArtifactRef (grep: only artifact_ref.py, task_artifacts.py and three runtime/nexus/artifacts modules use it). If they are not declared projections, digest, tenant scope and retention class may be absent on evidence, observability and reliability references. Not verified: they may be intentional link types.
recommendation: Campaign B: for each reference contract state whether it embeds or projects DurableArtifactRef and whether a digest is required; record the mapping in ARTIFACT_LIFECYCLE.md.

title: Vendor/backend replaceability has no architecture-doc or code-owned semantic owner; evidence and inventory live only in plan/qualification docs and test-side registries
affected_invariant: roadmap 3.0.8 non-negotiable objective; FRZ-RPL / FRZ-CTR family
impact: The platform-wide rule that every vendor dependency is classified and selected only through a sanctioned boundary is owned by a roadmap section and an evidence schema that disclaims being a PASS artifact; no docs/project/architecture/ doc names owners and no production module holds the live inventory. After ARCH-FREEZE the closed-world inventory depends on test-side registries being refreshed. Registry drift is not tested here.
recommendation: Owner decision: name a canonical architecture owner doc for VBN (or declare roadmap 3.0.8 plus the evidence spec as the owner in DOCUMENTATION_MAP) and state who refreshes the closed-world inventory after ARCH-FREEZE.

title: Scenario-facing contracts have no single semantic owner: four scenario mechanisms with overlapping names and no mapping to the SFX closed-world resolver
impact: At the baseline, scenario runtime (applications/_shared), core certification scenarios with mock evidence (runtime/evidence), a Tier-3 scenario matrix and scripts/proof scenario tooling coexist; the baseline contract sits under maintainers/plans and SCENARIO-READINESS-X has no architecture owner doc. SFX-P5+ must resolve requirements to these without creating a second engine; without a mapping the resolver may pick an unintended mechanism or add a duplicate. No defect shown: they may be intentionally distinct.
recommendation: Campaign B or the SFX owner: add a short scenario-mechanism map (which mechanism owns which scenario concept) before SFX-P5 and name the owner for SCENARIO-READINESS-X contracts.
